```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
```

---

## 1. Load Data

```{r load}
panel <- read_csv("../data/processed/final_data_monthly.csv",
                  col_types = cols(GEOID = col_character()))

demo <- read_csv("../data/processed/cbg_demographics.csv",
                 col_types = cols(GEOID = col_character()))

# Cross-section: average panel across all months, join demographics
cross <- panel %>%
  group_by(GEOID) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_delta_pm25   = mean(mean_delta_pm25,   na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_trips_worse   = mean(pct_trips_worse,   na.rm = TRUE),
    mobility_adj_pm25 = mean(mobility_adj_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    residential_pm25  = mean(residential_pm25,  na.rm = TRUE),
    n_destinations    = mean(n_destinations,    na.rm = TRUE),
    total_visitors    = mean(total_visitors,    na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(demo, by = "GEOID") %>%
  mutate(
    log_median_income = log(median_income),
    net_worse         = as.integer(mean_delta_pm25 > 0),
    state             = case_when(
      substr(GEOID, 1, 2) == "11" ~ "DC",
      substr(GEOID, 1, 2) == "24" ~ "MD",
      substr(GEOID, 1, 2) == "51" ~ "VA"
    ),
    income_q   = ntile(median_income,  4),
    nonwhite_q = ntile(pct_nonwhite,   4),
    noveh_q    = ntile(pct_no_vehicle, 4),
    poverty_q  = ntile(pct_poverty,    4)
  )

cat("Panel rows     :", nrow(panel), "\n")
cat("Unique CBGs    :", n_distinct(panel$GEOID), "\n")
cat("Time periods   :", n_distinct(panel$time_id), "months\n")
cat("Cross-section  :", nrow(cross), "CBGs\n")
```

---

## 2. Variable Summaries

```{r summaries}
# Panel outcome variables
panel %>%
  select(mean_delta_pm25, pct_trips_worse, mobility_adj_pm25,
         residential_pm25, n_destinations, total_visitors, pct_low_count) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    n      = sum(!is.na(value)),
    mean   = round(mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    sd     = round(sd(value,   na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    min    = round(min(value,  na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    median = round(median(value, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    max    = round(max(value,  na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 1. Panel Variable Summaries")
```

```{r demo-summaries}
# Demographic variables
cross %>%
  select(pct_white, pct_black, pct_asian, pct_hispanic, pct_nonwhite,
         median_income, pct_poverty, pct_no_vehicle,
         pct_college, pct_renter, total_pop) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    n      = sum(!is.na(value)),
    mean   = round(mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd     = round(sd(value,   na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    median = round(median(value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    max    = round(max(value,  na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 2. Demographic Variable Summaries (Cross-Section)")
```

## 3. Overall Exposure — Headline Numbers

```{r headline}
total_pop <- sum(cross$total_pop, na.rm = TRUE)

pw <- function(x, w) sum(x * w, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(w[!is.na(x)], na.rm = TRUE)

tibble(
  metric = c(
    "Total DMV population in sample",
    "Pop-weighted residential PM2.5 (ug/m3)",
    "Pop-weighted mobility-adjusted PM2.5 (ug/m3)",
    "Pop-weighted mean delta PM2.5 (ug/m3)",
    "Underestimation from ignoring mobility (%)",
    "People in net-worse CBGs",
    "People in net-worse CBGs (%)"
  ),
  value = c(
    format(total_pop, big.mark = ","),
    round(pw(cross$residential_pm25,  cross$total_pop), 3),
    round(pw(cross$mobility_adj_pm25, cross$total_pop), 3),
    round(pw(cross$mean_delta_pm25,   cross$total_pop), 3),
    round(pw(cross$mean_delta_pm25,   cross$total_pop) /
          pw(cross$residential_pm25,  cross$total_pop) * 100, 1),
    format(sum(cross$total_pop[cross$net_worse == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
           big.mark = ","),
    round(sum(cross$total_pop[cross$net_worse == 1], na.rm = TRUE) /
          total_pop * 100, 1)
  )
) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 3. Population-Level Exposure Summary")
```

## 4. Temporal Trends

```{r temporal, fig.cap="Figure 1. Monthly mean delta PM2.5 across DMV CBGs, 2018-2021."}
monthly <- panel %>%
  group_by(year, month) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_delta = mean(mean_delta_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_delta   = sd(mean_delta_pm25,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(paste(year, month, "01", sep = "-")))

ggplot(monthly, aes(x = date, y = mean_delta)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_delta - sd_delta,
                  ymax = mean_delta + sd_delta),
              alpha = 0.15, fill = "#2166ac") +
  geom_line(color = "#2166ac", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2020-03-01"),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2020-04-01"), y = max(monthly$mean_delta) * 0.95,
           label = "COVID-19\nMarch 2020", color = "red", size = 3, hjust = 0) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "6 months", date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean Delta PM2.5 (ug/m3)",
    title = "Monthly Mobility-Driven PM2.5 Exposure Differential",
    subtitle = "Shaded band = ±1 SD across CBGs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r period-comparison}
# Pre-COVID vs COVID era averages
panel %>%
  mutate(period = if_else(year %in% c(2018, 2019),
                          "Pre-COVID (2018-2019)",
                          "COVID Era (2020-2021)")) %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_delta_pm25  = round(mean(mean_delta_pm25,  na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    sd_delta_pm25    = round(sd(mean_delta_pm25,    na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    pct_trips_worse  = round(mean(pct_trips_worse,  na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    residential_pm25 = round(mean(residential_pm25, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    n                = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 4. Pre-COVID vs COVID Era Comparison")
```

```{r seasonal, fig.cap="Figure 2. Seasonal pattern in mean delta PM2.5 averaged across all years."}
panel %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_delta = mean(mean_delta_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    se         = sd(mean_delta_pm25,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(month_label = month.abb[month]) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(month, labels = month.abb), y = mean_delta)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2166ac", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_delta - se, ymax = mean_delta + se),
                width = 0.3, color = "gray40") +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Mean Delta PM2.5 (ug/m3)",
    title = "Seasonal Pattern in Mobility-Driven Exposure Differential",
    subtitle = "Error bars = ±1 SE"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

## 5. Who Is Exposed — Demographic Quartile Analysis

```{r quartile-tables}
# Helper for quartile summary
quartile_summary <- function(df, q_var, q_labels) {
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[q_var]]), !is.na(mean_delta_pm25)) %>%
    group_by(q = .data[[q_var]]) %>%
    summarise(
      n                = n(),
      mean_delta_pm25  = round(mean(mean_delta_pm25,  na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      sd_delta         = round(sd(mean_delta_pm25,    na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      pct_trips_worse  = round(mean(pct_trips_worse,  na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      pct_net_worse    = round(mean(net_worse,         na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(group = q_labels)
}

bind_rows(
  quartile_summary(cross, "income_q",
    c("Q1 (lowest)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4 (highest)")) %>% mutate(variable = "Income"),
  quartile_summary(cross, "noveh_q",
    c("Q1 (lowest)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4 (highest)")) %>% mutate(variable = "No-Vehicle"),
  quartile_summary(cross, "poverty_q",
    c("Q1 (lowest)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4 (highest)")) %>% mutate(variable = "Poverty"),
  quartile_summary(cross, "nonwhite_q",
    c("Q1 (most white)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4 (most nonwhite)")) %>%
    mutate(variable = "Pct Nonwhite")
) %>%
  select(variable, group, n, mean_delta_pm25, pct_trips_worse, pct_net_worse) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 5. Mean Delta PM2.5 by Demographic Quartile")
```

```{r quartile-chart, fig.cap="Figure 3. Mean delta PM2.5 by demographic quartile. No-vehicle and income show the clearest gradients."}
plot_quartile <- function(df, q_var, title, x_labels) {
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[q_var]]), !is.na(mean_delta_pm25)) %>%
    group_by(q = .data[[q_var]]) %>%
    summarise(mean_delta = mean(mean_delta_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
              se = sd(mean_delta_pm25, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(q, labels = x_labels), y = mean_delta)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#2166ac", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_delta - se, ymax = mean_delta + se),
                  width = 0.3, color = "gray40") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean Delta PM2.5", title = title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8))
}

p1 <- plot_quartile(cross, "noveh_q",  "No-Vehicle Quartile",
                    c("Q1\n(low)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4\n(high)"))
p2 <- plot_quartile(cross, "income_q", "Income Quartile",
                    c("Q1\n(low)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4\n(high)"))
p3 <- plot_quartile(cross, "poverty_q","Poverty Quartile",
                    c("Q1\n(low)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4\n(high)"))
p4 <- plot_quartile(cross, "nonwhite_q","Pct Nonwhite Quartile",
                    c("Q1\n(white)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4\n(nonwhite)"))

(p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Mobility-Driven Exposure Differential by Demographic Quartile",
    subtitle = "Error bars = ±1 SE"
  )
```

## 6. Population-Weighted Exposure

```{r pop-weighted, fig.cap="Figure 4. Population-weighted mean delta PM2.5 by demographic group."}
# Population counts by exposure threshold
thresholds <- c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0)

threshold_tbl <- map_dfr(thresholds, function(t) {
  sub <- cross %>% filter(!is.na(mean_delta_pm25), mean_delta_pm25 >= t)
  tibble(
    threshold  = t,
    n_cbgs     = nrow(sub),
    population = sum(sub$total_pop, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_total  = round(sum(sub$total_pop, na.rm = TRUE) / total_pop * 100, 1)
  )
})

threshold_tbl %>%
  mutate(population = format(population, big.mark = ",")) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 6. Population Above Each Exposure Threshold")

# Population-weighted delta by group
groups_pw <- bind_rows(
  cross %>%
    filter(!is.na(noveh_q)) %>%
    group_by(group = paste("No-Vehicle Q", noveh_q)) %>%
    summarise(pw_delta = sum(mean_delta_pm25 * total_pop, na.rm=TRUE) /
                         sum(total_pop, na.rm=TRUE),
              pop = sum(total_pop, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop"),
  cross %>%
    filter(!is.na(income_q)) %>%
    group_by(group = paste("Income Q", income_q)) %>%
    summarise(pw_delta = sum(mean_delta_pm25 * total_pop, na.rm=TRUE) /
                         sum(total_pop, na.rm=TRUE),
              pop = sum(total_pop, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop"),
  cross %>%
    filter(!is.na(state)) %>%
    group_by(group = state) %>%
    summarise(pw_delta = sum(mean_delta_pm25 * total_pop, na.rm=TRUE) /
                         sum(total_pop, na.rm=TRUE),
              pop = sum(total_pop, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
)

ggplot(groups_pw, aes(x = reorder(group, pw_delta), y = pw_delta,
                       fill = pw_delta)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(pw_delta, 3)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#4575b4", mid = "white", high = "#d73027",
                       midpoint = 0, guide = "none") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Population-Weighted Mean Delta PM2.5 (ug/m3)",
    title = "Population-Weighted Exposure Differential by Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  expand_limits(y = max(groups_pw$pw_delta) * 1.15)
```

## 7. Compound Exposure

```{r compound}
med_res <- median(cross$residential_pm25, na.rm = TRUE)
med_mob <- median(cross$mobility_adj_pm25, na.rm = TRUE)

cross %>%
  filter(!is.na(residential_pm25), !is.na(mobility_adj_pm25)) %>%
  mutate(exposure_type = case_when(
    residential_pm25 >= med_res & mobility_adj_pm25 >= med_mob ~ "Compound high",
    residential_pm25 >= med_res & mobility_adj_pm25 <  med_mob ~ "High res / low mob",
    residential_pm25 <  med_res & mobility_adj_pm25 >= med_mob ~ "Low res / high mob",
    TRUE ~ "Both low"
  )) %>%
  group_by(exposure_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cbgs        = n(),
    population    = sum(total_pop, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_of_total  = round(sum(total_pop, na.rm = TRUE) / total_pop * 100, 1),
    pw_nonwhite   = round(sum(pct_nonwhite  * total_pop, na.rm=TRUE) /
                          sum(total_pop, na.rm=TRUE), 1),
    pw_poverty    = round(sum(pct_poverty   * total_pop, na.rm=TRUE) /
                          sum(total_pop, na.rm=TRUE), 1),
    pw_income     = round(sum(median_income * total_pop, na.rm=TRUE) /
                          sum(total_pop, na.rm=TRUE), 0),
    pw_noveh      = round(sum(pct_no_vehicle* total_pop, na.rm=TRUE) /
                          sum(total_pop, na.rm=TRUE), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(population)) %>%
  mutate(population = format(population, big.mark = ",")) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 7. Compound Exposure Groups — Population and Demographics")
```

---

## 8. Correlation Matrix

```{r correlation, fig.cap="Figure 5. Pearson correlation matrix of key variables."}
corr_vars <- c("mean_delta_pm25", "residential_pm25", "mobility_adj_pm25",
               "pct_nonwhite", "pct_poverty", "log_median_income",
               "pct_no_vehicle", "pct_renter", "pct_college",
               "n_destinations")

corr_data <- cross %>%
  select(all_of(corr_vars)) %>%
  drop_na()

corr_mat <- cor(corr_data, method = "pearson") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("var1") %>%
  pivot_longer(-var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "r")

ggplot(corr_mat, aes(x = var1, y = var2, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(r, 2)), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#4575b4", mid = "white", high = "#d73027",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1),
                       name = "Pearson r") +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = NULL,
    title = "Correlation Matrix — Key Variables"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
